title: Mechanical set-intersection correction for D12.10-D1 owner-support localization
question: After correcting two invalid accepted-domain numerators to explicit set intersections, what true-owner support and Object Index alias counts are present in the immutable H1 data?
decisionRole: mechanical correction of an invalid post-hoc localization report; H1 remains bounded and C1 remains post-hoc

d1210InvalidResult.invalidReason: acceptedToTrueOwnerBilinear and acceptedToTrueOwnerFullStencil used total accepted as numerator and can exceed one

requirements: The corrected tool and output root do not exist at C1 preregistration.
The invalid D1 tool, result, payloads and emitted verdict remain byte-preserved.
C1 reads the same immutable H1 formal arrays and creates no Blender, model or network output.
No oracle, token, q, tap, stencil, classification, owner, threshold or H1 verdict semantic may change.

permittedChanges: Define acceptedWithinTrueOwnerBilinear as accepted AND trueOwnerBilinearCompatible.
Define acceptedWithinTrueOwnerFullStencil as accepted AND trueOwnerCurvatureCompatible.
Compute acceptedToTrueOwnerBilinear from acceptedWithinTrueOwnerBilinear divided by trueOwnerBilinearCompatible.
Compute acceptedToTrueOwnerFullStencil from acceptedWithinTrueOwnerFullStencil divided by trueOwnerCurvatureCompatible.
Add accepted-domain set decomposition and closed-unit-interval checks at cell and owner level.
Increase the attack minimum from 24 to 28 to cover the corrected intersections and decompositions.
Use C1 schema, experiment, output and verdict identities.
forbiddenChanges: changing any D12.10-D1 three-way classification or payload byte
changing any H1 formal byte or verdict
introducing a threshold, reconstruction candidate, coverage denominator or production claim
deleting or overwriting the invalid D1 output

correctedMeasurementContract.ownerAcceptedDecomposition: repeat both equalities independently for every analytic current owner
correctedMeasurementContract.ratioBounds: every non-null acceptedTo* ratio is within the closed interval [0,1]
correctedMeasurementContract.payloadIdentity: all five derived payload hashes must equal the preserved D1 hashes for every fixture and repeat
correctedMeasurementContract.classificationIdentity: every class count, alias count, one-sided opportunity and risk-after-full-stencil count must equal D1

requiredNewTargets: replace accepted intersection with total accepted
replace full-stencil accepted intersection with bilinear accepted
emit a ratio below zero or above one

decision.localizedWhen: Every original localization gate plus corrected payload identity, classification identity, set decomposition, ratio bound, alias exposure, operation and attack gate passes.
decision.noPromotion: C1 remains post-hoc and cannot validate a reconstruction intervention or revise H1.

nonClaims: C1 does not make the invalid D1 result valid; it emits a separate corrected result.
C1 is not a fresh holdout and does not select or validate a new candidate.
The 15 accepted owner aliases are localization evidence, not yet a demonstrated perceptual or production failure.
One-sided opportunity counts do not prove a one-sided estimator is safe.
No H1 coverage, quality or verdict label changes.
